jobs.description:
For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 
 
 
• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment. 
 
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.  
 
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic  
 
• Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.  
 
• Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
• Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  
 
• Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.  
 
• Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.  
 
• Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts. 

 
 
• Associate’s degree or High-School Diploma.  
 
• You have relevant warehouse experience with a strong affinity to the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
•  Detail oriented character with a strong affinity to perform administrative work, fill out forms, logbooks, follow regular trainings.  
 
• You have an ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and across different functions.  
 
• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills. 
 
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times.  
 
• Ability to work independently and successfully. 
 
• You speak very good English or Dutch.

The Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships while actively driving business growth. Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.
 
• Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives, and this is within the existing HighCo DATA services package.
 
• Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance and identify opportunities. 

 
• Strong sales and negotiation skills
 
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities in French, Dutch and English
 
• Customer-centric mindset with strong business acumen
 
• Ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue
 
• Proactive and results-oriented approach
 
• Strong organizational and time management skills
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
 
• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

This is a unique opportunity for you to join as an Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario.
 
 

• You will need to operate the right-hand seat for a minimum of 700 stick hours and successfully complete two Evidence Based Training (EBT) recurrent training modules. 

• Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course. 

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience:
 
 

• Minimum of 5,000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft) 

• Minimum of 2,000 hours command time on Boeing/ Airbus FBW types 

• Minimum 1,000 hours command time on Airbus FBW 

• Airbus FBW type flown within the past 3 years 

• Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on Airbus FBW/Boeing 

• Valid ICAO ATPL with matching Authority Class 1 Medical 

• ICAO English Level 5 or above  

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Are you a motivated and technically proficient pilot who delivers excellence?
 

We’re looking for Direct Entry Captains to join our growing team. To become one of our A350 or A380 Captains,
 
 

• you will need a minimum of 7,000 hours total flying time in multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft (only time in the operating seat of a turboprop and/or turbojet aircraft is counted; simulator time is excluded). 

Qualification
 

To become one of our Airbus Captains, you will need: 
 
 

• Minimum 7,000 hrs total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft)  

• Minimum 150 hrs in past 12 months on Airbus FBW as a Captain  

• A valid ICAO ATPL with a matching Authority Class 1 Medical  

• ICAO English level 5 or above  

For A380:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on Airbus FBW wide-body (A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW wide-body as a Captain   

For A350:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on any Airbus FBW (
A320/A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW as a Captain   

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:

Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Description

• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures

• Management of bank deposits

• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)

• 
Experience with SAP; DMS knowledge is an advantage.

Accurate, analytical, organized, and proactive.

•

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Headit is looking for an English- and French-speaking Sales Support Administrator for the Middle East & Africa regions.

• Very fluent communication skills in both French and English

Would you like to join a European organization that plays a key role in shaping the future of the lobbying sector? Our client is looking for an Assistant to support the activities of the Lobbying  sector.
 

In this role, you will provide administrative, organisational and communication support to the Sector Group Manager. You will also interact regularly with internal teams, industry members and external stakeholders.
 

This varied position offers the opportunity to contribute to event coordination, sector activities and communication management within a dynamic European environment.
 

Key Responsibilities

• Support sector management and advocacy activities 
 
• Assist with strategic engagement on key policy topics and interactions with policymakers

• Good knowledge of digital tools, website management and social media platforms

jobs.occupation: Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator in Machelen will support the life science industry by managing and maintaining customer service systems. This position requires a detail-oriented professional to ensure smooth operations and data accuracy.

Client Details

The company operates in the life science sector and is based in Machelen.

Description

As a Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator your responsibilities are:

• Maintain and update commercial systems to ensure data accuracy and reliability
• Support the customer service department with system-related inquiries and troubleshooting
• Monitor system performance and coordinate with IT teams for improvements
• Prepare and generate reports to provide insights for business decisions
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless workflow integration
• Train staff on system functionalities and updates when required
• Manage user access and permissions within the commercial system
• Analyze sales results
• Translate Data into specific Insights
 

As Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator you have following profile:

• You are a SAP Key user
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: you understand data and translate it into sales actions
• You master Excel
• Knowledge of customer service processes and systems
• Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
• Fluency in Dutch, English and French

I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.

As Foreman of the Spacer Production ZZ department, you are responsible for coordinating and supervising the production process. You provide operational leadership to a team of approximately 5 operators and ensure that production runs smoothly and according to quality standards and production targets.

You monitor the production schedule and progress and ensure the efficient use of employees, machines and materials. You perform quality checks, monitor process parameters and take corrective action when necessary.

You are also responsible for maintaining a safe working environment and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. You collect and analyse production data such as output, quality and productivity and report this information clearly to the Production Manager.

From a technical perspective, you carry out minor repairs, identify when components need preventive replacement and independently perform complex machine changeovers

 
• 
Demonstrable experience in a production environment.

 
• 
Good technical knowledge.

 
• 
Practical and hands-on approach.

 
• 
Interest in machinery and willingness to work alongside the production team.

 
• 
Natural leadership skills and the ability to lead by example.

 
• 
Good communication skills in Dutch and English.

 
• 
Ability to train and guide operators according to their knowledge and experience.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving skills.

 
• 
Ability to make decisions under pressure.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Good planning, organisational and prioritisation skills.
